main_measure.name: t of the daily mean of forecast/10-weighted drift-adjusted next-day returns

statistic.name: t of the mean over days

main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 with supporting check passing; reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third |forecast| mean drift-adjusted next-day return in forecast direction

decided_by: The main t is 2 or more and the top-third minus bottom-third difference is above 0.
reading: Profile bars are those whose recorded regime is the config's strategy regime 'unknown' (not 'chop'), the expected side is the opposite sign of the close's off-mid distance (raw value, prices where missing), cases are all active bars with a next bar in the window, days are UTC calendar days, and thirds are the lowest and highest n//3 cases ranked by |forecast| with unweighted means.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.003811 on the check folds against +0.008179 on every fold
